environment.description: Provider binary executed inside a distroless container image (gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12) with the container rootfs mounted read-only via Kubernetes SecurityContext (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true). No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volumes are attached to the pod. The container runtime (containerd 1.7.x with default seccomp) enforces that no tmpfs is auto-mounted at /tmp. The Kubernetes namespace has a ResourceQuota with LimitRange preventing ephemeral storage allocation. The OCI runtime spec sets 'readonly' on the root filesystem layer.
